last_result.mechanism: The guard fixes PROCESS (N3 truly enumerates and picks B correctly) but not JUDGMENT (D3 enumerates too, then says 'I will not open that new letter' while the letter is right there at list item 4).
last_result.deepest: LIST ORDER decides the DEFAULT FAILURE DIRECTION. OrderA first item = 'letter I have not read' -> failure is FALSE POSITIVE (claims a letter exists) -> leads to DO -> still recoverable by later items. OrderB first item = 'ShiZi has a new instruction' -> 'no instruction' is the safe default -> failure is FALSE NEGATIVE -> DO NOTHING is terminal. V2.9's 14 therefore contains a SAFETY CUSHION, not better judgment.
